brief.aim: The table was evidently assembled to model hourly bike rental demand, so the study predicts the total count column cnt from calendar, weather and time-of-day covariates, excluding the component counts casual and registered that sum to it.
brief.repeated_subjects: None; each row is a distinct hour, though 24 rows share each calendar day
brief.unit: One hourly record of a bike-share system (a single hour of a single day)
